title: Balance two batteries with the middle resistor
story: A 9 V battery and a 3 V battery are joined through two 1 kOhm resistors that meet at node b. The resistor from b to ground is missing. Pick it so that 1.6 to 2.0 mA flows from b toward the 3 V battery.

goals.label: 1.6 to 2.0 mA from b toward the 3 V battery

hints: Mesh equations with the slot called Rs (in kOhm): (1 + Rs) i1 - Rs i2 = 9 and -Rs i1 + (Rs + 1) i2 = -3.
The current in R3 is the right mesh current i2. A bigger Rs lifts node b, which pushes more current toward the 3 V battery.
